title: migrate heroku to kloudbean
linkedin:
> Work in five stages.

Inventory every dyno, add-on, config var, and scheduled job. Provision the equivalents on Kloudbean (a server for the app, a managed database, managed Redis if you use it). Map your `Procfile` processes to PM2, and copy config vars in as environment variables.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/migrate-heroku-to-kloudbean/

#Kloudbean #CloudHosting #DevOps #WebDev
